summary.background: Participating parties need to apply corresponding adjustment when accounting for the trading of ITMOs to avoid double counting.
summary.method: Under the condition that Korea maintains its intention to utilize the cumulative method of corresponding adjustment with single year NDC targets, this research aims to explore argumentative logics that defend current critiques against the cumulative method.
